definitions.gloss: outdoors; the open air; outside (a building)
definitions.explanation: The space outside the doors of a building. Formal and literary; common in written instructions, signage, and academic prose.

notes:
Compound of {戸|こ} (door) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). Literally 'outside the door,' i.e., outdoors.

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. In speech and everyday writing, ⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧ or ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ are far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戸外|こがい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: outdoor activity
- {戸外|こがい}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: outdoor exercise
- {戸外|こがい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: spend time outdoors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧: outdoor (of a building) — more common in modern usage; standard for signs and instructions
- ⟦{野外|やがい}→野外：17152_yagai⟧: outdoor (in nature) — emphasizes natural settings, used for concerts and festivals
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧: outside — everyday term; broadest in scope
